# 1. Why this page exists {#sec-why}

This document renders to HTML, PDF and Word with the `house-*` formats. The
manual number in the heading above is stripped by the build, so the rendered
heading is numbered by Quarto. A reference to @sec-tables shows that
cross-references resolve.

## 1.1 Links

A [web link](https://quarto.org) is always kept. A relative link to
[another Markdown file](other.md) becomes plain text in the PDF and Word
output, because that file is not part of this document.

## 1.2 Armenian script {#sec-armenian}

Armenian text renders in the PDF in Noto Serif Armenian, beside the Latin:
Հովհաննես Թումանյան, *Քաջ Նազար*, and **Երևան** or **Երեւան** in the two
orthographies. Inside sans-serif text, such as the headings, it switches to
Noto Sans Armenian instead.
